reason: Our students already get every notice on the class WhatsApp groups, and I cannot walk into a committee and ask for ₹9 lakh a year to replace something that costs us nothing. At most I would let one batch try the free pilot, but paying for it is not happening this month or this term.
objection: I don't have proof that students actually miss deadlines because of how notices reach them, rather than just ignoring them, and a small startup getting into our Microsoft 365 and ERP is a risk our IT and trustees will question.
would_change_my_mind: A pilot report from our own batch showing a clear drop in missed submissions, plus a reference from a similar private college that renewed after the first year.
